mapper.update: UPDATE sync_runs SET rows_read=#{rowsRead}, rows_written=#{rowsWritten}, progress_json=JSON_MERGE_PATCH(COALESCE(progress_json, '{}'), #{progressJson}), resumed=#{resumed}, checkpoint_from=COALESCE(#{checkpointFrom}, ''), checkpoint_rows=#{checkpointRows} WHERE id=#{id} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status='running'

UPDATE sync_runs SET status= #{status} , finished_at=datetime( 'now' ), rows_read=GREATEST(rows_read, #{rowsRead}), rows_written=GREATEST(rows_written, #{rowsWritten}), error=COALESCE( #{error} , '' ), note=COALESCE( #{note} , '' ), resumed= #{resumed} , checkpoint_from=COALESCE( #{checkpointFrom} , '' ), checkpoint_rows= #{checkpointRows}, progress_json=CASE WHEN #{progressJson} IS NULL THEN progress_json ELSE JSON_MERGE_PATCH(COALESCE(progress_json, '{}'), #{progressJson}) END WHERE id= #{id} AND status= 'running'

UPDATE sync_runs SET status= #{status} , finished_at=datetime( 'now' ), rows_read=GREATEST(rows_read, #{rowsRead}), rows_written=GREATEST(rows_written, #{rowsWritten}), error=COALESCE( #{error} , '' ), note=COALESCE( #{note} , '' ), resumed= #{resumed} , checkpoint_from=COALESCE( #{checkpointFrom} , '' ), checkpoint_rows= #{checkpointRows}, progress_json=CASE WHEN #{progressJson} IS NULL THEN progress_json ELSE JSON_MERGE_PATCH(COALESCE(progress_json, '{}'), #{progressJson}) END WHERE id= #{id} AND status= 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, status, started_at, finished_at, rows_read, rows_written, error, note, resumed, checkpoint_from, checkpoint_rows, progress_json FROM sync_runs WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, task_id, status, started_at, finished_at, rows_read, rows_written, error, note, resumed, checkpoint_from, checkpoint_rows, progress_json FROM sync_runs
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, task_id, status, started_at, finished_at, rows_read, rows_written, error, note, resumed, checkpoint_from, checkpoint_rows, progress_json, deleted_at FROM sync_runs WHERE task_id= #{taskId} AND id= #{runId}

SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.status, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.rows_read, r.rows_written, r.error, r.note, r.resumed, r.checkpoint_from, r.checkpoint_rows, r.progress_json FROM sync_runs r JOIN (SELECT task_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM sync_runs GROUP BY task_id) latest ON r.id = latest.id
SELECT count(*) FROM sync_runs WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'running'
SELECT id, task_id, status, deleted_at FROM sync_runs WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sync_runs SET deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND id=#{runId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('success','failed')
